criteria.evidence: Recommends creating 'a read-only DB user/role (GRANT SELECT only...) and give that to the tool' as the preferred fix, directly applying least privilege.
Explicitly rejects using admin credentials: 'No — don't do that... Nothing about your agent's use case needs write/delete access.'

States 'The actual capability gap: a read-only credential/tool for this database' and provides layered options (DB role, read replica, allowlist) all aimed at restricting to minimum required authorization, plus verification step to confirm writes fail.
criteria.criterion: Restrict the tool to the minimum required authorization.
